task.title: Decide: undo_one restoring copies into a soft-deleted collection
task.description: Filed from P6-110 (2026-08-09); recorded as an open question in specs/collection-deletion.md. undo_one is the only write path that skips require_owned_collection — its collection ids come from the moves ledger, so undoing an old, unrelated move could restore copies into a soft-deleted (hidden) collection once step 3 starts setting deleted_at. Needs a maintainer ruling before P6-188/step 3 lands: refuse the undo, redirect the copies to Inbox, or restore the collection. Specs: specs/collection-deletion.md.
